messages:
Samir (PM): ok team — SparrowLane pilot preflight: customer asked for go/no-go by EOD Friday. quick status pls: milestones, blockers, owners.

Alex R (Eng): API adapter done, tests green locally. still need infra creds from SparrowLane network team. pinged infra@ yesterday.

Maria T (SE): verified auth flow with their dev account. success criteria they care about: max p95 latency < 450ms, semantic-match accuracy on retrieval > 88%, and daily embed delta < 1%. noted.

Devon (Eng): CR #3421 for batching changes is out for review (2 approvals needed). small perf regressor fix in the PR — should shave ~30ms on warm cache. @Alex R can you take a look?

Alex R (Eng): on it, will review in the next 60m. also need to update the model pin in the deployment config to v1.3.2-quant. not optional for parity with staging.

Priya (CSM): SparrowLane legal requested data handling doc and a copy of the rolling retention policy. I uploaded drafts to the shared drive: https://redwood/sparrowlane/paperwork

Samir (PM): Owners: Alex = integration + config, Devon = runtime changes + CR, Maria = acceptance tests / success criteria, Priya = customer comms / docs, infra team = network & creds. any gaps?

Alex R (Eng): infra creds = blocker. infra ETA?

deploy-bot: infra-deploy-check: network-egress-rule missing for 10.42.0.0/16 to sparrowlane-vpn. Ticket INF-881 created.

Devon (Eng): Filed INF-881 comment with required ports and examples. if infra can't enable today, fallback is running proxy in our VPC (adds ~80ms).

Maria T (SE): customer would accept proxy but wants to know cost/latency tradeoff. I'll run quick perf numbers tomorrow AM and share.

Samir (PM): ok plan: 1) Alex finish model-pin + config change (today, noon PT) 2) Devon merge CR #3421 (today, 3pm PT) 3) infra to resolve INF-881 or we spin up proxy (decision by 5pm PT) 4) Maria run acceptance perf (tomorrow AM) 5) Priya send docs (today). Anybody can't meet those windows?

Alex R (Eng): model-pin done, pushing config now. will post commit hash.

Devon (Eng): CR approved by me, @alex pushed a minor fix, merging after CI passes (should be within 45m).

Priya (CSM): docs sent to SparrowLane legal — waiting ack, but they got them.

Maria T (SE): noted. I'll queue perf run for 8:30am PT Tue and add results to the acceptance sheet. link: https://redwood/sparrowlane/acceptance

Samir (PM): great. final ask — if anyone runs into something that pushes decision past EOD Fri, flag here immediately. i'll escalate to infra lead. thanks all :thumbsup:

Alex R (Eng): commit: 7c9a2f4 (config/model-pin). shared in the repo.

Devon (Eng): merged CR #3421, CI green. routing policy tests still flaky but non-blocking for this pilot.

deploy-bot: deploy-plan: canary to 2 nodes in us-west-2, fallback route -> small-cap model variant.

Samir (PM): excellent. we'll reconvene if infra doesn't close INF-881 by 17:00 PT. otherwise this moves to staging tomorrow morning.

Priya (CSM): copying SparrowLane stakeholders on timeline now.

Maria T (SE): adding a quick checklist to acceptance sheet for the SLOs and test prompts.

Samir (PM): thanks everyone — I'll close the loop after infra update.
